rules: Never reuse a situation/threat/twist. Any 7 videos: >=3 formats, no format >3 times, no same format twice in a row.

episodes.situation: a menacing cucumber creeps toward Nugget; the viewer's hand blocks it twice
episodes.twist: Nugget sniffs it, bites it: it was a pickle; heart eyes, '10/10 would eat again'
episodes.title: Protect Nugget from the cucumber! 🥒😱

episodes.situation: 3AM: the clock flips to 3:00 and Nugget goes full zoomies, knocks a mug off the nightstand while staring at the camera
episodes.twist: owner turns the lamp on: Nugget is instantly 'asleep' in loaf pose; lights off, clock 3:01, ROUND 2
episodes.title: Why is it ALWAYS exactly 3AM? 😭🐈

episodes.situation: viewer pets Nugget with a finger; he purrs so hard he inflates and floats up like a balloon
episodes.twist: he deflates, drops, gets dizzy, then raises a paw: 'AGAIN?'
episodes.title: Put your finger here to pet Nugget 👆🐱

episodes.twist: turns green and sour-faced, throws the lemon, eyes the plate again ('AGAIN?')
episodes.title: Nugget tried a lemon for the first time 🍋😖

episodes.situation: a loud vacuum cleaner charges at a napping Nugget; the viewer's hand blocks it and switches it off
episodes.twist: Nugget puts on sunglasses and rides the vacuum around the room: 'NEW RIDE UNLOCKED'
episodes.title: Protect Nugget from the vacuum! 😱🧹

episodes.situation: owner bought Nugget an $80 fancy bed; he tries it and is unimpressed
episodes.twist: he spots the cardboard box it came in, falls in love and squeezes in: 'EVERY. SINGLE. TIME.'
episodes.title: $80 bed vs the box it came in 📦😂

episodes.situation: Nugget stalks a fish swimming on a TV nature show and pounces at the screen
episodes.twist: he smacks the glass, the TV cracks to NO SIGNAL, he searches behind the TV; the fish comes back and he gives the camera a deadpan look: 'he's been trying for 3 years'
episodes.title: Nugget vs the fish on TV 📺🐟
